title: Education and Development: Main Exam, 26 April 2018
department: Department of Social and Development Studies
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B

parts.text: Explain how education brings about change in the way people live.
Explain why education is an important indicator for measuring development.
Identify the factors that promote problems of access and inequality in education.
Highlight any three aims of Kenya's education system and their effects on Kenya's economic development.
Explain why education is considered a social instrument for developing human capital in a nation.
Discuss the reasons behind financing of education for work in agriculture and industry.
Explain the contributions of non-formal and vocational education in promoting development in education.
Highlight Kenya's policy of vocational education in economic development.

items.text: The worldwide declaration on Education for All (EFA) is a worthwhile course. Discuss this statement with regard to the positive and negative effects of EFA.

parts.text: Explore some elements of African indigenous education that you think would be relevant to modern education.
The kind of education system in any given society reflects its society's influence. Citing relevant examples, discuss.
